Giant African Land Snails and Big Brown Snails Outdoor Adventure:

I come to find insects, bugs, millipedes, snails, centipede, beetle, larvae, and all small creatures just to take the video about finding and discover insect. 

Some of them live in the water, and out of the water as frog, crab, and snails.
Some of them live in the wet place as millipede, centipede, snails, larvae, and red spotted millipede.
Some of them live in the dried place as worms, scorpions, giant millipede, snakes, lizard, and beetle.

I learnt a lots about insect, millipede, bug, snake, snails, and beetle about where they are living, and when we easy find.

I never let's them dead in my hand, because I always released them free back in the nature.

Thank you for paying attention and always support.
